title: PWOL synthetic comparison of tiered drawdown controls
author: Pengyi Peng
calibration: NONE; no seed selection, return targets, threshold sweeps or outcome-driven changes

samples.benchmark: Common fee-free buy-and-hold, initially 25% of each synthetic asset; each scenario has its own single matched benchmark

decision: Own net prior close NAV against own known peak. Downward jumps may skip tiers; restore at most one tier per decision, after minimum completed sessions since any switch and consecutive qualifying closes at that tier. Mark gaps before trades; no input from the new open or from scoring windows to the risk rule.

success.basis: Per scenario and per fee rate: positive MDD improvement versus original and at least 80% of any positive binary improvement; strictly higher net rebound-window return than binary. Terminal return, turnover and fees reported separately.
